description: Reference moves recorded by the unlisted-input sweeps of 2026-10-05 on the frozen US run: every output whose reference moves by more than $1 (or flips) when an engine estimate of an unlisted input takes the prompt's literal reading or a documented alternative. Read by tests/test_prompt_contract_v2_required_facts.py; rebuilt by build_unlisted_input_sweep_fixture.py.

unlisted_input_sweep.note: Recorded before #196's head 44850656, which adds Part B's not_enrolled reading; re-record after #196 merges.

payroll_scope_sweep.reading: payroll_mandatory_scope leaves the optional employer pass-through shares out of employee state payroll tax

estimates.why_unlisted: No prompt states state income tax withheld or paid during the year (26 U.S.C. 164(a)(3), (b)(5)).
No prompt states a locality or a local sales tax rate.
No prompt states Medicare enrollment or a Part B premium, and the prompt says not to infer unlisted expenses or health coverage.
Prompts state the state, never the county.
Most prompts list no hours worked.
Prompts list mortgage balances and interest, never when the mortgage was taken out (26 U.S.C. 163(h)(3)(F)).
Prompts list SSDI income, never how long it has been received.
Prompts say a person is disabled, never whether the disability meets the Social Security definition.

No prompt states whether the employer deducts the employee share of a state paid-leave or disability premium that the law lets it deduct but does not require; the engine counts the largest permitted share.
